lessons.title: Introduction to Django

content.title: What is Django?
content.text: Django is a Python web framework designed for building web applications quickly and with a clear structure.

content.title: Django Architecture
content.text: Django commonly follows a Model-View-Template architecture. Models handle data, views handle application logic and templates handle presentation.

content.title: Create a Project
content.code:
django-admin startproject myproject
cd myproject
python manage.py runserver

key_points: Django is a Python web framework.

lessons.title: Projects and Applications

content.title: Project vs App
content.text: A Django project contains the configuration for a complete website, while an app is a component that provides a particular feature.

content.title: Installed Apps
content.text: An application normally needs to be added to INSTALLED_APPS in the project's settings.py file.

content.title: manage.py
content.text: manage.py is used to run development commands such as starting the server, creating migrations and creating administrative users.

key_points: An app provides a specific feature.
manage.py is used for common Django commands.

lessons.title: URLs and Views

content.title: URL Routing
content.text: Django uses URL patterns to map incoming web requests to views.

content.title: Basic View
URL Pattern
content.code:
from django.urls import path
from . import views

urlpatterns = [
    path('', views.home, name='home'),
]

content.title: Views
content.text: A view receives a request and returns a response. A response may contain HTML, JSON or other content.

key_points: HttpResponse can return a simple response.

lessons.title: Templates

content.title: Django Templates
content.text: Templates allow HTML pages to contain dynamic data supplied by views.

content.title: Render a Template
Template Tags
content.text: Django templates provide tags for operations such as loops and conditional rendering.

content.title: Template Loop

key_points: Views can pass context data to templates.
Template variables use double curly braces.
Template tags can implement loops and conditions.

lessons.title: Models and Databases

content.title: Django Models
content.text: A Django model is a Python class that represents data stored in a database.

content.title: Basic Model
content.code:
from django.db import models

class Student(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    age = models.IntegerField()
    email = models.EmailField()

content.title: ORM
content.text: Django's Object-Relational Mapper allows developers to work with database records using Python objects instead of writing SQL for every operation.

content.title: Migrations
content.text: Migrations record changes to model definitions and apply those changes to the database.

content.title: Migration Commands
content.code:
python manage.py makemigrations
python manage.py migrate

key_points: QuerySets are used to retrieve database records.

lessons.title: Forms and User Input

content.title: Django Forms
content.text: Django forms simplify collecting and validating user input.

content.title: Basic Form
content.code:
from django import forms

class StudentForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=100)
    email = forms.EmailField()

content.title: ModelForm
content.text: ModelForm can automatically generate form fields based on a Django model.

content.title: ModelForm
Validation
content.text: Django forms validate submitted data and provide information about invalid fields.

key_points: POST requests are commonly used to submit form data.

lessons.title: Django Admin

content.title: Django Admin
content.text: Django provides a built-in administrative interface that can be used to manage application data.

content.title: Register a Model
content.code:
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Student

admin.site.register(Student)

content.title: Admin Interface
content.text: After registering models and creating a superuser, administrators can manage records through the Django admin site.

key_points: Django includes a built-in admin interface.
Models can be registered with admin.site.register().
The admin interface is useful for managing application data.

lessons.title: CRUD and Django Application Structure

content.title: CRUD
content.text: CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update and Delete. These operations form the foundation of many database-driven applications.

content.title: Application Structure
content.text: A typical Django application separates models, views, URLs, templates, forms and administrative configuration into appropriate files.

key_points: CRUD means Create, Read, Update and Delete.
Django ORM provides methods for CRUD operations.
